name: harness-memory
description: Keeps a repo's Claude Code memory layer healthy, against criteria from official Claude Code docs. audit checks CLAUDE.md, a root AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .claude/rules/, and auto-memory for structure, size, placement, and index integrity, with scripted and judgment checks. stateless inspects, disables, and (after confirmation) purges Claude-written auto memory across settings scopes. Whether instruction text fits the current model belongs to harness-config.
